# Grant Jenks

> > Portfolio and documentation hub for Grant Jenks' open-source Python libraries including Sorted Containers, DiskCache, RunStats, WordSegment, Tribool, and Free Python Games.

Grant Jenks is a software developer and Microsoft alumnus who maintains several popular Python packages. This site serves as both a personal portfolio and comprehensive documentation resource for his open-source contributions to the Python ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Sorted Containers
- DiskCache
- Data Structures
- Sorted Collections
- Open Source
- Python Libraries
- CPython
- PyPy
- RunStats
- WordSegment
- Tribool
- Free Python Games
- Performance Benchmarks
- Django Integration

- [Grant Jenks](https://grantjenks.com): Homepage showcasing Grant Jenks' Python projects and portfolio
